summary: Pataad is a farm-based maker of fresh, pre-fried fries for the hospitality sector, based in Haps, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands. Brothers Willem and Arjan Ardts grow the potatoes on their own fields and began processing them into fries in early 2022. The fries are delivered in cooled vehicles.
ownership: Family business of the Ardts brothers
products: Fresh pre-fried fries (verse friet) for hospitality
markets: Hospitality sector (horeca), supplied directly from the grower
facts: Began processing its own potatoes into fries in early 2022
Potatoes spend about 100 days in the ground on average before harvest
Fresh fries are packed in recycled crates
limitations: The website has only a home page and a contact page and does not publish the legal name, KvK number, capacity, volumes, employee numbers or turnover.
